metadata.scope: Canonical effect-row rendering, lockfile-backed ceiling validation, generated contract and determinism proofs, documentation and migration note. No performed-effect inference or loader coupling.
metadata.velocity_basis: The seven-day history has planning-only work, so the approved design's one-day estimate receives one additional day for tests, golden migration, documentation, and verification.

features.description: Sort a defensive copy of the manifest effect ceiling before rendering, preserve the historical Env/FS default, and prove equivalent declaration orders produce identical generated bytes.
acceptance_criteria: Non-empty effect rows render in canonical sorted order without mutating manifest input
Different declarations of the same effect set generate byte-identical files
Omitted or empty effects.max continues to render Env, FS

features.description: Validate every registered package's locked declared effects as a subset of the host manifest ceiling and return stable, package-specific errors before writing output.
acceptance_criteria: An out-of-ceiling package fails before template output replacement
The error names the package and sorted offending effects
The implementation reads existing lock metadata without package loading or type-checking

features.description: State ceiling semantics in the generated header, update the golden artifact, and prove idempotent regeneration plus type-check compatibility of reordered equal effect rows.
acceptance_criteria: Generated header identifies the row as the manifest effects ceiling and a superset bound
Two unchanged regeneration runs produce exactly identical bytes
Golden output reflects only the approved canonical order and contract comment
ailang check accepts equivalent effect rows in different label orders

features.description: Document ceiling semantics, canonical ordering, migration, and violation remediation; add the release note and run focused and package-level quality gates.
acceptance_criteria: The motoko extension guide explains ceiling-versus-performed semantics and sorted ordering
The active changelog notes the one-time generated-byte migration and issue 800
Focused and full cmd/ailang tests pass
go vet for cmd/ailang and git diff --check pass
